mustFix.title: The live remasurement assigns DR-118 the wrong closed-vocabulary register token
evidence: Live file 08 line 300 gives DR-118 the distinct token DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, not OPEN.

File 08 lines 19-28 define OPEN and DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED as different members of the closed status vocabulary: OPEN means the decision is not yet taken, while DECIDED means product authority has decided the posture but integration remains.
The current DR-118 leftover remasurement, language-quality-leftover-join.v3, carries file08StatusToken DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, and adopted D-206 records that exact standing.

Nothing in this G14 leftover-remasurement draft changes DR-118, so it has no basis to replace the live token with OPEN. The incorrect phrase occurs once; the correct token occurs zero times in the draft.
mustFix.impact: Adoption would append a false live-register recital to COORD and contradict both the measured file-08 bytes and the current D-206 lineage. The error is conservative rather than authority-expanding, but OPEN and DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED are not synonyms and the decision posture is load-bearing provenance.
mustFix.whyMustFix: This is a measured-current-state claim in the draft's expressly named Live remasurement section, using a backticked member of a closed status taxonomy. Coordinator adoption cannot preserve a known false row token even when the rest of the act has zero readiness effect.
